## New: Virtual dimmer support

Virtual dimmers now support both incoming control requests from free@home and
on/off state and brightness feedback from Home Assistant.

Enable **Include virtual devices?** in the integration options. Each virtual
dimmer channel provides a **Light** entity for state and brightness feedback,
plus three **Event** entities for switching, relative dimming press/release,
and absolute brightness requests.

Use automations to apply incoming requests to your real light and mirror its
actual state back to the virtual light. Requests do not automatically change
reported state, and no real light is linked automatically. Relative dimming
behavior must also be handled by your automations.

[Setup instructions and automation guidance](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass/wiki/Virtual-Devices#dimactuator)
